personalInfo.name: Kevin Aguilar
personalInfo.title: Senior Full Stack Developer | JavaScript, Node.js & MEAN
personalInfo.location: San José, Costa Rica (Available for Global / Remote)
personalInfo.summary: Senior Full Stack Developer with 8+ years in JavaScript and TypeScript, specializing in Angular, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB. Project work includes transactional commerce and inventory (Taurus), WhatsApp/email integrations (Megaphone), and case management with PDF/DOCX automation (Folio). Design layered APIs, data models, session-based access controls, reactive interfaces, SSR, and CI delivery workflows. Author of open-source Express.js utilities, with additional experience in React, enterprise frontend architecture, and rendering performance.

experiences.summary: Modular business platform connecting an Angular application to a TypeScript REST API for catalog, inventory, sales, buyer checkout, and QR table ordering.
highlights: Build Angular 22 standalone interfaces with Signals, signal-based HTTP resources, lazy feature routes, reusable form controls, and configurable business branding.
Structure an Express 5 and MongoDB backend with separated routes, controllers, domain services, and a central OWL model registry; reuse the code across business deployments with separate databases.
Coordinate stock movements, sales, and checkout with MongoDB transactions, server-side pricing, revision checks, and idempotency keys to prevent duplicate inventory reservations.
Connect kitchen and table workflows through session-authorized Socket.IO channels and MongoDB change streams; enforce staff roles and buyer ownership on the API.
Integrate ONVO payment intents and signed webhooks, Cloudinary/TinyPNG image processing, and CI checks for types, architecture, tests, and builds.

experiences.summary: Full stack messaging application for contact management, multi-number WhatsApp campaigns, email, inbound messages, and per-recipient send history.
highlights: Build an Angular 22 client with standalone components, lazy feature routes, typed API contracts, session guards, and permission-aware dashboard navigation.
Implement a TypeScript, Node.js, Express 5, and MongoDB API with MongoDB-backed sessions, owner-scoped contacts and messages, permission middleware, and action logging.
Integrate WAHA for multi-number WhatsApp messaging and inbound webhooks, plus Nodemailer for email; track per-recipient outcomes and retain request IDs across retries.
Process media with Sharp and Cloudinary, import contacts from CSV/XLSX/JSON, and protect provider credentials with server-side encryption.
Separate public Angular SSR pages from the client-rendered private dashboard, with hydration, a same-origin API proxy, and GitHub Actions delivery to Cloudflare Pages.

experiences.summary: Legal workflow and document automation platform organizing cases, processes, clients, and versioned document drafts with controlled lawyer/client access.
highlights: Develop an Angular 22 frontend with strict TypeScript, standalone OnPush components, Signals, httpResource, lazy routes, and responsive Tailwind CSS 4 interfaces.
Design a layered Express 5 API with domain services and a central OWL/MongoDB model registry; enforce lawyer ownership and explicit client sharing on case reads and document downloads.
Generate PDF and editable DOCX working drafts from versioned templates and validated inputs, preserving document snapshots and recording professional review.
Implement revocable HttpOnly sessions and separate account administration from legal-record access; keep private views and responses outside public SSR data transfer.
Validate access isolation, document generation, and revocation with integration tests against temporary MongoDB; build Node SSR release artifacts with GitHub Actions.

experiences.summary: Full stack development and software architecture for MacheTico, a multi-tenant, white-label SaaS and CRM platform for small and medium businesses in Costa Rica.
highlights: Design the multi-tenant software architecture, connecting a React frontend with a Node.js and Express backend and a MongoDB data layer.
Develop backend APIs and authentication flows with JWT, httpOnly cookies, bcrypt password hashing, and tenant-scoped access controls.
Build reusable frontend interfaces and configurable branding with shared components, tenant themes, and accessible color contrast.
Structure the application for multiple business types, including restaurants, clinics, hotels, and online stores, within a shared codebase.
Manage deployment workflows with GitHub Actions, Cloudflare, and Render for the frontend and backend.
Implement Cloudflare Workers that send requests to reactivate the backend hosted on Render.

experiences.summary: Spearheading client-side performance engineering and state modernization for enterprise core applications.
highlights: Spearheaded core performance optimization, drastically cutting down layout thrashing and client-side rendering bottlenecks.
Refactored legacy reactive state management patterns to leverage fine-grained reactivity and Signals, eliminating redundant re-render cycles.
Pioneered codebase modernization by migrating legacy structural syntax (*ngIf, *ngFor) to modern control flow blocks (@if, @for) and standalone component topologies.
Collaborated across cross-functional engineering teams to enforce clean architecture, strict TypeScript typing, and scalable code standards.

experiences.summary: Built reusable Angular and React interfaces and collaborated on Node.js REST API design, connecting enterprise frontend architecture with backend data contracts.
highlights: Architected and authored an enterprise-grade reusable component library adopted across multiple core products to accelerate feature velocity and maintain visual coherence.
Partnered closely with backend engineering teams to design resilient Node.js REST APIs and streamline end-to-end data contracts.
Led the upgrade of core frontend solutions to modern frameworks, integrating design systems and robust NgRx global state management.
Improved modular application scaling and reduced initial payload size by engineering Micro-Frontends via Webpack Module Federation.
Advocated and implemented strict accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) and performance testing benchmarks.

experiences.summary: Designed and engineered custom 2D/3D JavaScript rendering engines, WebGL pipelines, and cloud asset pipelines powering 35+ commercial slot and scratch games for CoinBox Studio (coinboxstudio.com).
highlights: Designed and led the architectural foundation of custom JavaScript interactive rendering engines and Canvas API systems powering 35+ commercial games for CoinBox Studio.
Implemented high-performance real-time graphics pipelines using PIXI.js and WebGL for interactive web experiences running locked at 60 FPS.
Engineered cloud-hosted application delivery workflows and optimized multi-region asset distribution on AWS S3 CDN (cdn.coinboxstudio.com).
Mentored junior and mid-level software engineers on JavaScript runtime mechanics, memory management, garbage collection avoidance, and design patterns.

experiences.summary: Developed JavaScript and React web applications integrated with AWS serverless backends and MongoDB/MySQL datastores.
highlights: Developed responsive web solutions and high-converting marketing applications with strong emphasis on UX, micro-interactions, and conversion rate optimization.
Built interactive user interfaces utilizing JavaScript, React.js, and modern CSS layout models.
Integrated frontend clients with AWS serverless backends and relational/NoSQL datastores (MySQL, MongoDB).

experiences.summary: Built mission-critical logistics tracking applications for national export agency (Procomer).
highlights: Engineered modular UI components for Procomer's national logistics and international shipment tracking platform.
Visualized real-time order status updates and asynchronous telemetry streams using RxJS observable architectures.
Optimized HTTP streaming and caching layers via Nginx web servers.

experiences.summary: Architected cross-platform mobile solutions with React Native and Expo.
highlights: Built cross-platform mobile applications using React Native, Expo, Redux Toolkit, and TypeScript.
Engineered shared business logic layers between web and mobile targets to minimize code duplication.
Benchmarked native thread performance, frame drops, and touch gesture responders.

architectureShowcase.title: Taurus: Transactional Commerce & Real-Time Operations
architectureShowcase.description: A shared application codebase with isolated business deployments and transactional domain operations.
architectureShowcase.problem: Orders, stock, payments, and kitchen views must remain consistent across concurrent staff and buyer actions.
architectureShowcase.solution: Use layered REST endpoints and OWL-managed MongoDB transactions for writes; publish change-stream invalidations through authorized Socket.IO channels and reload state through scoped HTTP reads.
architectureShowcase.impact: Checkout retries avoid duplicate reservations, failed stock operations roll back together, and active order views refresh from authoritative server state.
layers: Express REST API · Sessions · Roles · Domain Services
OWL · MongoDB Transactions · Stock / Orders / Payments

architectureShowcase.title: Megaphone: Messaging Integrations & Scoped Access
architectureShowcase.description: A permission-aware messaging backend serving an Angular dashboard and public SSR pages.
architectureShowcase.problem: Multiple sender numbers, external providers, retries, and private contact data require explicit ownership and traceable send results.
architectureShowcase.solution: Keep provider calls and encrypted credentials on the server, authorize contacts and messages by owner and permission, and record request IDs and recipient outcomes behind typed frontend services.
architectureShowcase.impact: Users manage sender channels, imports, campaigns, and send history from one interface while private API data stays outside public SSR output.
layers: WAHA WhatsApp · SMTP / Nodemailer · Sharp / Cloudinary

architectureShowcase.title: Folio: Case Access & Versioned Document Generation
architectureShowcase.description: Case-based legal workflows with server-side document generation and separate public/private rendering.
architectureShowcase.problem: Legal records need controlled sharing, revocable downloads, and stable document content as templates evolve.
architectureShowcase.solution: Authorize every case, process, and download on the API; generate PDF/DOCX through domain services using versioned templates and preserve immutable text snapshots. Public SSR transfers anonymous data only.
architectureShowcase.impact: Template updates preserve existing drafts, clients access only explicitly shared cases, and account administrators have no access to legal records.
layers: Angular · Public SSR / Private Case Workspace
Express · Session / Role / Ownership / Sharing Checks

architectureShowcase.title: Enterprise Micro-Frontend Architecture with Module Federation
architectureShowcase.description: De-coupling large monolithic enterprise portals into independently deployable micro-apps with shared runtime dependencies.
architectureShowcase.problem: Multiple engineering teams deploying to a single monolithic repo caused deployment bottlenecks, bundle bloat (>5MB), and regression risks on cross-team updates.
architectureShowcase.solution: Designed a Shell Host architecture utilizing Webpack Module Federation. Configured shared singleton vendor packages (React, Angular, UI tokens) and lazy-loaded remote containers on demand.
architectureShowcase.impact: Cut initial bundle download by 45%, eliminated cross-team deployment blockers, and allowed squads to deploy remotes independently in CI/CD without re-building the host.

architectureShowcase.title: Fine-Grained Reactivity & Signal-Based State Migration
architectureShowcase.description: Transitioning heavy UI trees from dirty-checking zone-based reactivity to surgical graph dependency updates.
architectureShowcase.problem: Deeply nested component trees triggering broad change detection cycles resulted in frame drops during high-frequency data streams.
architectureShowcase.solution: Implemented fine-grained reactive primitives (Signals) and memoized computed derivations. Replaced legacy structural directives with compiler-optimized control flow (@if, @for).
architectureShowcase.impact: Eliminated 70% of unnecessary tree traversals, achieving smooth 60 FPS under continuous WebSocket data streams.

architectureShowcase.title: Custom High-Performance 2D/WebGL Rendering Engine
architectureShowcase.description: Ground-up architecture for real-time interactive canvas animations, particle physics, and WebGL batch rendering.
architectureShowcase.problem: DOM-based elements lacked the throughput required for rendering hundreds of animated sprites, particle physics, and interactive effects simultaneously on web browsers.
architectureShowcase.solution: Architected a requestAnimationFrame-driven game loop with dirty-rectangle optimization, spatial partitioning (quad-tree), and PIXI.js WebGL batch draw calls with memory pooling to avoid GC spikes.
architectureShowcase.impact: Guaranteed locked 60 FPS performance across lower-spec mobile and desktop browsers with 1,000+ active interactive entities.

architectureShowcase.title: Enterprise Scalable Component Library & Design Tokens
architectureShowcase.description: A single source of truth component ecosystem engineered for accessibility, themeability, and multi-app scalability.
architectureShowcase.problem: Five distinct product portals suffered from inconsistent UX, redundant CSS implementations, and zero centralized accessibility governance.
architectureShowcase.solution: Authored an atomic design system with CSS custom properties tokens, headless logic hooks, keyboard navigation primitives, and automated visual regression testing.
architectureShowcase.impact: Adopted across 5+ enterprise applications, reducing new feature UI scaffolding time from 2 weeks to 3 days with WCAG 2.1 AA compliance.

openSourceLibraries.name: owl-expressjs-utils
openSourceLibraries.description: Enterprise-grade reusable TypeScript utilities for building scalable Express.js applications backed by MongoDB and Mongoose. Provides composable building blocks for MongoDB connection management, session authentication, AES-256-GCM encryption, bcrypt hashing, and automated CRUD model/controller factories.
features: Generic Mongoose model factories with built-in CRUD, population, search, and pagination
Session-based authentication middleware & CORS origin allowlist governance
Hardware-accelerated AES-256-GCM encryption and bcrypt password security
Express controller & entity factories for standardized production REST endpoints

openSourceLibraries.name: Reactive Values
openSourceLibraries.description: A lightweight, zero-dependency JavaScript & TypeScript library designed to provide a fine-grained reactivity system. Define atomic reactive signals (SignalValue), observe dependency changes with automatic listener dispatch, and compose memoized computed values (ComputedValue) with minimal overhead.
features: SignalValue primitive with surgical subscriptions and fine-grained updates
ComputedValue with memoized re-evaluations and topological dependency tracking
Automatic dependency graph tracking via .effect() listeners
Zero external runtime dependencies with 100% strict TypeScript types
